verdicts.reason: A is readable and has no collisions, but it has clear flaws. The bottle cap sticks out of its cream circle almost to the top edge. The headline is left-aligned while the NEW and Try It pills are right-aligned, so the layout has no shared alignment. The NEW badge is nearly as heavy as the CTA, and the bottom and left areas are empty. B is broken: the white headline sits on the cream circle and is almost unreadable, the bottle cuts through 'Orange' and 'Sunset', and the Try It button overlaps the bottle label.
